SVC_WIFI_CONNECTION.name: Sony Wi‑Fi Connection
SVC_WIFI_CONNECTION.description: SongPal BLE Wi‑Fi setup (SSID/password/IP/DMR). Used by speakers and similar products; present in Sound Connect’s shared BLE SDK.

SVC_BT_CONNECTION.name: Sony BT Connection
SVC_BT_CONNECTION.description: Legacy Bluetooth connection control over BLE (connection + mode). Newer headphone OOBE prefers dedicated pairing services instead.

SVC_BT_MULTI_AUDIO.name: Sony BT Multi Audio
SVC_BT_MULTI_AUDIO.description: Multi-room / multi-player audio group control (master capability, join/leave group, role, player count).

SVC_BT_BROADCAST_AUDIO.name: Sony BT Broadcast Audio
SVC_BT_BROADCAST_AUDIO.description: Broadcast / Party-connect style group control (broadcast capability and group status variants).

SVC_NW_SETTING_EXT_APP.name: Sony Network Setting
SVC_NW_SETTING_EXT_APP.description: Network setup status when assisted by an external app path.

SVC_BLUETOOTH_PAIRING.name: Sony Bluetooth Pairing
SVC_BLUETOOTH_PAIRING.description: Classic BR/EDR pairing arming over BLE.

SVC_BLUETOOTH_IAP_CONNECTION.name: Sony Bluetooth iAP Connection
SVC_BLUETOOTH_IAP_CONNECTION.description: iOS MFi / iAP-oriented Bluetooth connection control and status.

SVC_MODEL_INFORMATION.name: Sony Model Information
SVC_MODEL_INFORMATION.description: Exposes model feature flags (Spotify, GVA, Chromecast, Alexa, DLNA, etc.).

SVC_WIFI_CONNECTION2.name: Sony Wi‑Fi Connection 2
SVC_WIFI_CONNECTION2.description: Second-generation Wi‑Fi setup service (same Wi‑Fi characteristics plus Key Information).

SVC_PARTY_CONNECT.name: Sony Party Connect
SVC_PARTY_CONNECT.description: Party Connect / broadcast-group pairing (shares broadcast group characteristics).

SVC_BLUETOOTH_IAP_CONNECTION_MC.name: Sony Bluetooth iAP Connection (MC)
SVC_BLUETOOTH_IAP_CONNECTION_MC.description: iAP connection path for Music Center–class products.

SVC_SSH_DEVICE_REGISTRATION.name: Sony SSH Device Registration
SVC_SSH_DEVICE_REGISTRATION.description: Sony Home / soundbar-TV registration and OOBE (versions, OOB, seeds signing, HDMI/ACS/TV power triggers). Optional characteristics tolerated at discovery.

SVC_BLE_PAIRING_HBS_HPC.name: Sony BLE Pairing HBS (HPC)
SVC_BLE_PAIRING_HBS_HPC.description: LE pairing assist for over-ear (HBS) headphones: LE mode, LE ad packet id, target-announcement LE ad.

SVC_BLE_PAIRING_TWS_HPC.name: Sony BLE Pairing TWS (HPC)
SVC_BLE_PAIRING_TWS_HPC.description: LE pairing assist for true-wireless (TWS) buds: LE mode, L/R ad packet ids, target-announcement LE ad (Sound Connect writes Target Announcement = REQUEST).

SVC_SSH_WIFI_SHARING.name: Sony SSH Wi‑Fi Sharing
SVC_SSH_WIFI_SHARING.description: Wi‑Fi credential sharing for SSH products (control/SSID/password, IP info, RSA key, connection status).

SVC_SSH_LAUNCH_TV_FUNCTION.name: Sony SSH Launch TV Function
SVC_SSH_LAUNCH_TV_FUNCTION.description: Write trigger to open a TV function/screen (e.g. BCA usage setting).

SVC_TANDEM_V2_HPC.name: Sony Tandem V2 (HPC)
SVC_TANDEM_V2_HPC.description: Post-bond MDR control pipe for headphones over BLE (Tandem). Init: DETERMINE_MTU notify → read WRITABLE_VALUE_LENGTH → write TO_ACC / notify FROM_ACC with opaque MDR frames.

SVC_TANDEM_V2_MC.name: Sony Tandem V2 (MC)
SVC_TANDEM_V2_MC.description: Tandem V2 pipe for Music Center–class accessories (MC TO/FROM ACC).

SVC_TANDEM_V1_MC.name: Sony Tandem V1 (MC)
SVC_TANDEM_V1_MC.description: Older Tandem V1 Music Center pipe; may include Ready-To-Start-Initial-Communication.

SVC_TANDEM_V1_FIESTABLE.name: Sony Tandem V1 (Fiestable)
SVC_TANDEM_V1_FIESTABLE.description: Tandem V1 pipe for Fiestable products.

SVC_TANDEM_SSH.name: Sony Tandem SSH
SVC_TANDEM_SSH.description: Tandem pipe for soundbar/SSH devices; may expose Optimal MTU.

SVC_BLUETOOTH_PAIRING_COMPLETE_NAME.name: Sony Bluetooth Pairing (Complete Name)
SVC_BLUETOOTH_PAIRING_COMPLETE_NAME.description: Classic pairing arming when the ad capability requires a long/complete friendly name: Inquiry Scan + chunked name via COMPLETE_NAME notify and SYNC index write.

SVC_LE_AUDIO_CAPABILITY_HPC.name: Sony LE Audio Capability (HPC)
SVC_LE_AUDIO_CAPABILITY_HPC.description: LE Audio switch / compatibility probe for headphones (Sound Connect 13.x). App reads LE_AUDIO_SWITCH_SUPPORTED_COMPATIBILITY.

SVC_BLUETOOTH_CTKD_PAIRING.name: Sony Bluetooth CTKD Pairing
SVC_BLUETOOTH_CTKD_PAIRING.description: Cross-transport key derivation pairing (Sound Connect 13.x). Same Inquiry Scan arming, then reads Bluetooth Public Address for createBond/CTKD.

SVC_BLANC_FOTA.name: Sony Blanc / SSS FOTA
SVC_BLANC_FOTA.description: Firmware-over-the-air sink/request/notification characteristics (Blanc and SSS command paths). Codec’d in the app; headphone UI often updates via other transports.

CHR_CONNECTION_STATUS.name: Sony Connection Status
CHR_CONNECTION_STATUS.description: Wi‑Fi (or similar) connection status / result. Parent: Wi‑Fi Connection / Wi‑Fi Connection 2.

CHR_CONNECTION_CONTROL.name: Sony Connection Control
CHR_CONNECTION_CONTROL.description: Start/end Wi‑Fi setting (0 = START_WIFI_SETTING, 1 = END_WIFI_SETTING). Parent: Wi‑Fi services / SSH Wi‑Fi Sharing.

structure.description: 0 = start Wi‑Fi setting, 1 = end Wi‑Fi setting

CHR_DMR_UUID.name: DMR UUID
CHR_DMR_UUID.description: DLNA DMR UUID bytes for Wi‑Fi / renderer discovery.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_CONNECTION.name: Bluetooth Connection
CHR_BLUETOOTH_CONNECTION.description: Bluetooth connect/control write on BT Connection and iAP connection services.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_MODE.name: Bluetooth Mode
CHR_BLUETOOTH_MODE.description: Write Bluetooth radio mode. Sound Connect OOBE writes 0x01 = INQUIRY_SCAN to put the headset into classic discoverable/pairing-ready mode (parents: Pairing / Complete Name / CTKD / also BT Connection).

CHR_BLUETOOTH_CONNECTION_STATUS.name: Bluetooth Connection Status
CHR_BLUETOOTH_CONNECTION_STATUS.description: Status for iAP Bluetooth connection services.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_MODE_STATUS.name: Bluetooth Mode Status
CHR_BLUETOOTH_MODE_STATUS.description: Notify after Bluetooth Mode write. 0x00 = SUCCESS, 0x01 = FAIL (BooleanStatus). Enable CCCD before writing Inquiry Scan.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME.name: Bluetooth Friendly Name
CHR_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME.description: Read short classic BT friendly name (UTF‑8, typically ≤20) after successful Inquiry Scan on BLUETOOTH_PAIRING_SERVICE; used to filter CompanionDeviceManager associate.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_LE_MODE.name: Bluetooth LE Mode
CHR_BLUETOOTH_LE_MODE.description: LE pairing mode write for HBS/TWS HPC pairing services.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_LE_MODE_STATUS.name: Bluetooth LE Mode Status
CHR_BLUETOOTH_LE_MODE_STATUS.description: Notify status for LE mode changes (BooleanStatus).

CHR_LE_AD_PACKET_IDENTIFIER.name: LE Ad Packet Identifier
CHR_LE_AD_PACKET_IDENTIFIER.description: LE advertisement packet identifier (HBS pairing service).

CHR_TARGET_ANNOUNCEMENT_LE_AD.name: Target Announcement LE Ad
CHR_TARGET_ANNOUNCEMENT_LE_AD.description: Ask the Provider which LE advertisement to emit for pairing. Sound Connect TWS path writes 0x01 = REQUEST.

CHR_COMPLETE_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME.name: Complete Bluetooth Friendly Name
CHR_COMPLETE_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME.description: Notify of full/long friendly-name chunks (complete-name pairing service).

CHR_SYNC_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME_INDEX.name: Sync Bluetooth Friendly Name Index
CHR_SYNC_BLUETOOTH_FRIENDLY_NAME_INDEX.description: Write which name chunk index to deliver next during complete-name pairing.

CHR_BLUETOOTH_PUBLIC_ADDRESS.name: Bluetooth Public Address
CHR_BLUETOOTH_PUBLIC_ADDRESS.description: Read classic BD_ADDR (public) after CTKD Inquiry Scan success; used for address-targeted createBond.

CHR_GROUP_STATUS.name: Group Status
CHR_GROUP_STATUS.description: Multi-audio group state machine status (+ result).

CHR_ROLE_OF_DEVICE.name: Role of Device
CHR_ROLE_OF_DEVICE.description: SINGLE / MASTER / PLAYER role for multi or broadcast audio.

CHR_NUMBER_OF_PLAYER.name: Number of Player
CHR_NUMBER_OF_PLAYER.description: Player count in a multi/broadcast group.

CHR_GROUP_CONTROL_BROADCAST.name: Group Control Broadcast
CHR_GROUP_CONTROL_BROADCAST.description: Broadcast variant of group control commands.

CHR_MODEL_FEATURES.name: Model Features
CHR_MODEL_FEATURES.description: Feature bit set (Spotify Connect, Google Voice Assistant, Chromecast, Alexa master/follower, DLNA DMR, …).

CHR_TANDEM_HPC_TO_ACC.name: Tandem HPC → Acc
CHR_TANDEM_HPC_TO_ACC.description: Write-without-response opaque MDR frames from phone to headset (Tandem V2 HPC).

CHR_TANDEM_HPC_FROM_ACC.name: Tandem HPC ← Acc
CHR_TANDEM_HPC_FROM_ACC.description: Notify opaque MDR frames from headset to phone (Tandem V2 HPC).

CHR_TANDEM_MC_TO_ACC.name: Tandem MC → Acc
CHR_TANDEM_MC_TO_ACC.description: Write MDR frames to Music Center–class accessory (Tandem V1/V2 MC).

CHR_TANDEM_MC_FROM_ACC.name: Tandem MC ← Acc
CHR_TANDEM_MC_FROM_ACC.description: Notify MDR frames from Music Center–class accessory.

CHR_TANDEM_FIESTABLE_TO_ACC.name: Tandem Fiestable → Acc
CHR_TANDEM_FIESTABLE_TO_ACC.description: Write MDR frames to Fiestable accessory.

CHR_TANDEM_FIESTABLE_FROM_ACC.name: Tandem Fiestable ← Acc
CHR_TANDEM_FIESTABLE_FROM_ACC.description: Notify MDR frames from Fiestable accessory.

CHR_TANDEM_SSH_TO_ACC.name: Tandem SSH → Acc
CHR_TANDEM_SSH_TO_ACC.description: Write MDR frames to SSH/soundbar accessory.

CHR_TANDEM_SSH_FROM_ACC.name: Tandem SSH ← Acc
CHR_TANDEM_SSH_FROM_ACC.description: Notify MDR frames from SSH/soundbar accessory.

CHR_LE_AUDIO_SWITCH_COMPATIBILITY.name: LE Audio Switch Compatibility
CHR_LE_AUDIO_SWITCH_COMPATIBILITY.description: Read 1-byte LE Audio switch supported compatibility version (LE_AUDIO_CAPABILITY_FOR_HPC).

CHR_BLANC_FOTA_READY_TRANSFER.name: Blanc FOTA Ready Transfer
CHR_BLANC_FOTA_READY_TRANSFER.description: Blanc FOTA ready/handshake (empty or short status).

CHR_BLANC_FOTA_DATA_SIZE.name: Blanc FOTA Data Size
CHR_BLANC_FOTA_DATA_SIZE.description: Preferred FOTA chunk size enum (e.g. 4 KB … 2 MB).

CHR_WRITABLE_VALUE_LENGTH.name: Writable Value Length
CHR_WRITABLE_VALUE_LENGTH.description: Read uint16 fragment size used for Tandem write-without-response framing.

CHR_DETERMINE_MTU.name: Determine MTU
CHR_DETERMINE_MTU.description: Notify MtuStatus during Tandem BLE init (enable notify, wait, then disable).

CHR_OPTIMAL_MTU.name: Optimal MTU
CHR_OPTIMAL_MTU.description: Optimal MTU hint on Tandem SSH service.

CHR_SSH_FIRMWARE_VERSION.name: SSH Firmware Version
CHR_SSH_FIRMWARE_VERSION.description: UTF‑8 firmware version string on SSH_DEVICE_REGISTRATION (soundbar/TV class — not used on the headphone pairing GATT path).

CHR_IP_INFORMATION.name: IP Information
CHR_IP_INFORMATION.description: Composite IP/status for SSH Wi‑Fi Sharing.

CHR_SEEDS_SIGNING_AND_DEVICE_REGISTRATIO.name: Seeds Signing and Device Registration
CHR_SEEDS_SIGNING_AND_DEVICE_REGISTRATIO.description: SSH seeds signing / device registration write.

CHR_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGER.name: Notification Trigger
CHR_NOTIFICATION_TRIGGER.description: Write which SSH/Wi‑Fi status characteristic to push (IP_INFORMATION, seeds, device id, …).

CHR_SSH_RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_GENERATION_TRIGGE.name: SSH RSA Public Key Generation Trigger
CHR_SSH_RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_GENERATION_TRIGGE.description: Trigger generation of SSH RSA public key material.

CHR_SSH_HDMI_CONNECTED_DEVICE_HASH_TRIGG.name: SSH HDMI Connected Device Hash Trigger

CHR_SSH_HDMI_CONNECTED_DEVICE_HASH_STATU.name: SSH HDMI Connected Device Hash Status

CHR_SSH_ACS_SUPPORT_INFO_GET_TRIGGER.name: SSH ACS Support Info Get Trigger
CHR_SSH_ACS_SUPPORT_INFO_GET_TRIGGER.description: Trigger Acoustic Center Sync (ACS) support-info fetch.

CHR_SSH_ACS_TV_SPEAKER_SETTING_TRIGGER.name: SSH ACS TV Speaker Setting Trigger

CHR_SSH_ACS_TEST_TONE_PLAYBACK_TRIGGER.name: SSH ACS Test Tone Playback Trigger

CHR_SSH_LAUNCH_TV_FUNCTION.name: SSH Launch TV Function
CHR_SSH_LAUNCH_TV_FUNCTION.description: Write launch-TV-function trigger (e.g. open settings screen).
